answer: A bond is refunded only after 21 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The falcon counter is kept in ridge and thread shows each reset. An adversary as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 21 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The per-identity price is 5 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
